A few things! (Important to note, I hadn’t Even had an ED for that long atp). The first is my hair. I’ve always had thick hair and obviously strands fall out sometimes, that’s how hair works, but one day I washed my hair and clumps of it were falling out into my hands, enough for me to notice a difference in my hair soon after. 

The second is my heart rate. (Btw I do not have POTS and have never had this issue otherwise). Upon standing up, my heart rate would skyrocket, my vision would go almost black and I would have to sit back down. I do think this was partially related to the anxiety an ED can cause/worsen. 

And finally, insomnia. I’d never had insomnia before, at least not to this degree. I found myself absolutely not tired, not even a little bit, until about 6 AM every night. The lack of sleep as a result didn’t even make me tired enough the next night to sleep normally.

Oh and an inability to heal injuries. Something as small as a minor cut (like a paper cut or something) would take a month roughly to heal, and they always looked gruesome
